title: Site, Climate, and Light Planning Workbook
purpose: Provide a traceable planning record for site suitability, seasonal flowering, weather baselines, microclimates, shade, and outdoor light exposure.

sections.title: Site Suitability Decision
sections.decisionPrompt: Which limiting factor is most likely to make this site unsuitable or require professional assessment?

sections.title: Seasonal Flowering Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the observed flowering response match the local daylength history for this cultivar?

sections.title: Climate and Weather Baseline
sections.decisionPrompt: Which recent condition differs most from the long-term planning baseline?

sections.title: Microclimate Mapping Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Where does the site create repeatable cold, wet, hot, or wind-exposed risk zones?

sections.title: Outdoor Light and Shade Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does integrated light exposure explain the crop response better than a single midday reading?

qualityRules: Record methods and locations so observations can be repeated.
Separate long-term climate baselines from current weather.
Do not use one cultivar's flowering response as a universal calendar.
Preserve spatial variation instead of averaging away risk zones.
